title: Thai -> English dictionary (data/i18n_en.json, ui/i18n_extra.json)
description: Keys are Thai strings or fragments (the page matches the longest key first inside any text), values are the English. A value may not contain Thai (tests/battle/english.js and tests/render/test_screens.gd fail on Thai left on screen); validate_data.py checks that in code because the one exception is the language name itself, which the language button shows in its own script.
